meta.name: paid-ads-linkedin
meta.description: Audit, diagnose, plan, and safely operate connected LinkedIn Ads accounts through the NotFair MCP, with an export-based fallback. Use for LinkedIn advertising, sponsored content, lead-generation forms, job-title or company targeting, campaign groups, creatives, conversions, lead quality, budgets, bids, or approved LinkedIn campaign changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断领英广告账户并安全执行投放调整
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在管理领英广告账户,需要安全地诊断和调整投放。
copy.tagline_en: Audit, diagnose, and safely adjust your LinkedIn ad campaigns.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage LinkedIn ad accounts and want safe ways to diagnose and adjust them.

howto.what: 装上该技能后,Claude 可通过 NotFair 连接器或导出文件,检查并诊断 LinkedIn 广告账户,制定优化方案;经你批准后,能安全地修改预算、出价、定位等,并报告改动和回滚方式。
howto.when: 当你的请求涉及 LinkedIn 广告投放,例如赞助内容、线索表单、定向、预算等;或要求审计、诊断、规划、修改广告账户时触发。

say.text: 审计我的 LinkedIn 广告账户,找出花费高但转化差的广告组。
say.note: Claude 会连接账户、读取数据并生成诊断报告。

say.text: 把出价超过 5 美元的广告系列先暂停,给我预览。
say.note: 执行前它会展示改动和回滚方案。

say.text: 分析最近 30 天线索质量,按职位职能分组给优化建议。
say.note: 它会区分线索数量与质量,基于数据建议。

howto.what_en: Claude audits, diagnoses, plans, and safely operates LinkedIn Ads via NotFair MCP or export. It reports metrics and executes approved changes (budgets, bids, targeting) with rollback details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the request involves LinkedIn advertising (sponsored content, lead forms, targeting, budgets, etc.) or asks to audit, diagnose, plan, or modify an ad account.

say_en.text: Audit my LinkedIn Ads account and find high-spend, low-conversion ad groups.
say_en.note: It connects, reads data, and produces a diagnostic report.

say_en.text: Pause campaigns with bids over $5, but show me a preview first.
say_en.note: It shows the changes and rollback before executing.

say_en.text: Analyze lead quality by job function and suggest optimizations.
say_en.note: It separates lead quantity from quality, then advises.
